scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:frontend
scripts.rebuild:packages: npm run clean:packages && npm run build:packages
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@step-wise/api
scripts.dev: npm run rebuild:packages && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names packages,api,frontend --prefix-colors cyan,yellow,magenta "npm:watch:packages:incremental" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test:packages && npm run test:api && npm run test:frontend
scripts.typecheck:api: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace=@step-wise/api
scripts.watch:packages: npm run clean:packages && npm run watch:packages:incremental
